reviewed_by: Codex focused review for actor-scoped workspace provenance
reason: The change adds bounded Git dirty-path provenance to Core, persists actor and subagent ownership, and exposes the receipt through chat lifecycle and automatic command hook envelopes. The selection covers exact/pre-existing/other/concurrent/unsupported classification, store-reopen durability, durable native-hook envelope shape, all turn-ending lifecycle variants, automatic before/after command hooks, blocking before-hook cleanup, and the regression that command execution itself never walks the workspace.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. Frontend, Rust/native code, browser/device behavior, API routes, provider wire formats, mission orchestration, and unrelated harness adapters are unchanged. The production Core journey is exercised manually after immutable deployment because it validates the installed binary and authenticated native-hook path rather than a browser presentation surface.
